<?php
/**
 * CI/CD Pipeline Authentication Bridge
 * Handles cross-service token validation between build agents and deployment targets
 */

namespace Pipeline\Auth;

use Redis;

class TokenBridge
{
    private Redis $redis;
    private string $hmacSecret;
    private int $tokenTTL = 30; // seconds

    public function __construct(Redis $redis, string $hmacSecret)
    {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->hmacSecret = $hmacSecret;
    }

    /**
     * Issue a deployment token after build agent authenticates
     */
    public function issueDeployToken(string $buildId, string $agentId, array $permissions): string
    {
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $timestamp = time();
        
        $payload = json_encode([
            'build_id' => $buildId,
            'agent_id' => $agentId,
            'permissions' => $permissions,
            'nonce' => $nonce,
            'issued_at' => $timestamp,
            'expires_at' => $timestamp + $this->tokenTTL
        ]);

        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacSecret);
        $token = base64_encode($payload) . '.' . $signature;

        // Register token as pending - deployment target must claim it
        $this->redis->setex(
            "pending_token:{$nonce}",
            $this->tokenTTL,
            json_encode(['token' => $token, 'claimed' => false, 'build_id' => $buildId])
        );

        return $token;
    }

    /**
     * Deployment target claims and validates a token
     */
    public function claimToken(string $token, string $targetServiceId): ?array
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }

        $payload = base64_decode($parts[0]);
        $providedSig = $parts[1];

        // Verify HMAC signature
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacSecret);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            return null;
        }

        $data = json_decode($payload, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['nonce'])) {
            return null;
        }

        // Check expiration
        if (time() > $data['expires_at']) {
            return null;
        }

        $redisKey = "pending_token:{$data['nonce']}";
        
        // Atomic claim using Redis WATCH/MULTI for race condition prevention
        $this->redis->watch($redisKey);
        
        $record = $this->redis->get($redisKey);
        if (!$record) {
            $this->redis->unwatch();
            return null;
        }

        $recordData = json_decode($record, true);
        
        // Check if already claimed
        if ($recordData['claimed'] === true) {
            $this->redis->unwatch();
            return null;
        }

        // Mark as claimed atomically
        $recordData['claimed'] = true;
        $recordData['claimed_by'] = $targetServiceId;
        $recordData['claimed_at'] = time();
        
        $tx = $this->redis->multi();
        $tx->setex(
            $redisKey,
            $this->tokenTTL,
            json_encode($recordData)
        );
        $result = $tx->exec();
        
        // If transaction failed, another service claimed it first
        if ($result === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'build_id' => $data['build_id'],
            'agent_id' => $data['agent_id'],
            'permissions' => $data['permissions'],
            'claimed_by' => $targetServiceId
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Verify that a token was properly claimed by the expected service
     * Called by orchestrator to confirm deployment authorization
     */
    public function verifyClaimChain(string $token, string $expectedClaimant): bool
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return false;
        }

        $payload = base64_decode($parts[0]);
        $providedSig = $parts[1];

        // Re-verify signature before trusting payload
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->hmacSecret);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            return false;
        }

        $data = json_decode($payload, true);
        
        if (!$data || !isset($data['nonce'])) {
            return false;
        }

        $redisKey = "pending_token:{$data['nonce']}";
        $record = $this->redis->get($redisKey);
        
        if (!$record) {
            return false;
        }

        $recordData = json_decode($record, true);
        
        return $recordData['claimed'] === true 
            && $recordData['claimed_by'] === $expectedClaimant;
    }
}

/**
 * Pipeline Orchestrator - coordinates build and deploy phases
 */
class PipelineOrchestrator
{
    private TokenBridge $tokenBridge;
    private array $authorizedTargets;

    public function __construct(TokenBridge $tokenBridge, array $authorizedTargets)
    {
        $this->tokenBridge = $tokenBridge;
        $this->authorizedTargets = $authorizedTargets;
    }

    /**
     * Execute deployment after build completion
     */
    public function authorizeDeployment(string $buildId, string $agentId, string $targetId): ?string
    {
        if (!in_array($targetId, $this->authorizedTargets, true)) {
            return null;
        }

        $permissions = $this->resolvePermissions($buildId, $targetId);
        
        return $this->tokenBridge->issueDeployToken($buildId, $agentId, $permissions);
    }

    /**
     * Confirm deployment was claimed by correct target
     */
    public function confirmDeployment(string $token, string $targetId): bool
    {
        return $this->tokenBridge->verifyClaimChain($token, $targetId);
    }

    private function resolvePermissions(string $buildId, string $targetId): array
    {
        // In production, this queries a policy engine
        return ['deploy', 'restart_service', 'health_check'];
    }
}
